nodes.label: CLAUDE.md: Project Instructions
nodes.rationale: Project-wide conventions and guidelines for code organization, testing, deployment and repository management.

nodes.label: GLUE: Global Library Unified Exporter
nodes.rationale: GLUE is a local-first web app for DJs that builds a music collection from folders and DJ-app libraries, analyzes quality/BPM/key, manages playlists and events, finds duplicates, and exports back to Rekordbox and Engine DJ. Grew from Speklone (spectral forensics).

nodes.label: Vault: Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: The project's memory and decision record: how GLUE works (SYSTEM.md), current state (handoff), roadmap, features, ADRs, research, and changelog are kept in vault/ and updated in every session.

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable: Local-First, No Server
nodes.rationale: No GLUE server that sees music. Website works on its own, accounts optional. GLUE Home is the user's own program; audio goes only between the user's own computers. One writer of GLUE folder at a time.

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable: JSON Files, No Database
nodes.rationale: GLUE's data is JSON files in the user's GLUE folder (ADR 0009). Simplifies format, allows offline access, and keeps data portable.
